name: Władysław Miączyński

events.note: Heir of Pawłowo from his father and of the Trąbczyn estate from his uncle Włodzimierz; he signed the death notice of 1879 as the nephew.
In the court church at Dresden.
"Which his grandson Władysław Count Miączyński holds today" (Żychliński 1885).

Słowo of 4 January 1892: bought "from Count Miączyński" by Countess Władysławowa Wielopolska for 225,000 rubles - Maria Wielopolska, born Plater-Zyberk (1857-1909), wife of Władysław hr. Wielopolski (1860-1928), married at Warsaw on 12 February 1885. The notice does not print the seller's forename; he was Władysław, heir since 1879. No family link between the buyer and the Miączyńskis, Prusimskis or Dąmbskis has been found; in 1896 his cousin Tadeusz bought the estate back.

notes: Count; married Helena Potocka at Dresden.
The buyer of 1892 in Minakowska's database: lu.22334 (Maria hr. Plater-Zyberk) and lu.22335 (Władysław hr. Wielopolski), married at Warsaw, St Alexander's, act 55/1885.
